hook: Patancheru hit *13.1°C* today, Hyderabad's coldest reading
hook_b: Patancheru hit *13.1°C* today, Hyderabad's coldest reading
tldr: Hyderabad and several Telangana districts stayed cold on Monday, with minimums close to 11°C in some districts; IMD forecasts morning mist and haze until Nov 19.

beats.what: HCU Serilingampally and BHEL recorded 13.4°C, Rajendranagar 14.1°C and Moula Ali 14.2°C.
beats.why: Weatherman T Balaji says the night chill should ease after Nov 18 as Cyclone Akvan brings rain.
beats.care: IMD Hyderabad forecasts partly cloudy skies with mist and haze in the mornings until Nov 19; no cold or rain warning has been issued.
